run_async_fallback: run async fallback across model groups when the original model call fails
get_fallback_model_group: get fallback model groups and generic fallback index from a fallbacks configuration list
log_success_fallback_event: log a successful fallback event to all registered custom logger callbacks
log_failure_fallback_event: log a failed fallback event to all registered custom logger callbacks
_check_non_standard_fallback_format: check if a fallbacks list uses non-standard format of strings or parameter dicts
